scope: Frozen checkpoint depth screen; omit blocks and their residual history; retain original physical query/mask/attention identities; no fine-tuning. Bypassed arrays remain stored. Six leave-one-out and six fixed three/four-block subsets.
checks: Native and copied full-depth identity must match exactly. Zeroing every bypassed block must leave per-sequence loss exactly unchanged.
selection: Select depth candidates by agreement/latency on these calibration batches. Freeze top six non-identity strategies by small-model agreement for larger model; confirm finalists together on fresh batches before transfer.
